title: Watermarks on Your Inventory Images? We Can Help.
description: Our partnerships with key inventory platforms let us clean up watermarked images for a better buyer experience.

props.text: Product · 1 min read · By Jerry Van Galder
A Buzznerd–Sandhills API integration that removes spreadsheet watermarks and keeps inventory in sync.

The digital landscape is constantly evolving to provide the best user experiences possible. In this journey, our partnerships — particularly with key players like Sandhills (parent company of Truck Paper and Machinery Trader) — play a pivotal role.

We've observed that certain inventory images now bear a ‘Crane’ watermark for those who upload inventory using a spreadsheet. We want to bring this to your attention and offer an opportunity to fix it with our Buzznerd–Sandhills API system.
Benefits of the Buzznerd–Sandhills API System

By adopting this automated solution, you no longer upload spreadsheets, and you ensure a seamless, consistent visual representation on your platform — effectively addressing the watermark issue. It also enhances reliability and guarantees timely website inventory updates.

The API integration involves a minimum monthly fee, but we're waiving the customary setup fees for existing and new clients. Our team is here to help with the Sandhills integration or any CRM/ERP integration questions.
